posts.title: John Lawson’s New Voyage to Carolina Illustrated Using AI
posts.description: John Lawson (1674-1711) wrote the first book about the natural history of America, and he published it during 1709. The book is entitled A New Voyage to Carolina. The book covers his 2-month journey across North and South Carolina during January and February of 1700. It also includes information about the local natural history that […]

posts.title: The Journal of Thomas Walker and his Journey Through Kentucky in 1750 Illustrated Using AI
posts.description: The 2nd part of my series using AI to illustrate accounts of early American explorers is a pictorial version of Thomas Walker’s journal. Dr. Walker, along with 5 other men, traveled through what today is Kentucky and West Virginia during 1750 when the former was Indian hunting territory used by overlapping tribes. posts.title: William Bartram’s Travels Illustrated Using AI
posts.description: I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve read and re-read passages of William Bartram’s Travels. William Bartram was a botanist who traveled through Southeastern North America, especially Georgia and Florida during 1775 and 1776.
